title: feat(011clk): (0,1,1) label and cost-1 filter both fire 12/12
science: Mechanical repeat of #6726 with the cheaper reverser (0,1,1) (nu minus the seed-exit clause) in place of nu: N_label_fire=12, N_filt_fire=12, same derived reason (center support 3, neighbors support 2 or 3, so no clause fires inward). Logically subsumed by #6726 -- (0,1,1)'s expensive set is a subset of nu's, so if no nu clause fires inward none of (0,1,1)'s can. Low marginal content.
